يستجليان (form X)
# يَسْتَجْلِيَانِ (yastajliyāni) /jas.tad͡ʒ.li.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
# يُسْتَجْلَيَانِ (yustajlayāni) /jus.tad͡ʒ.la.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
